config._doc: Harness configuration (owner: harness agent). REQUIRED (review M3: no silent defaults). See bench/harness/README.md. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Source of the flag table: bench/README.md section 3 (fp axis licensed / repro / fastmath, coordinator 2026-10-17) and bench/notes/fortran-notes.md.

controls.name: compute
controls._why: README 6 drift control: compute-bound RK4, deterministic

controls.name: memory
controls._why: README / coordinator 2026-10-17: memory-bound control, three 5.6 MB streams (saxpy sizes.control n = 700,001); needs a saxpy/control pin

tolerance._why: relative checksum tolerance vs the pin; kernel.json `tolerance` may override per kernel

config._serial_affinity_why: review M20: serial arms pinned to logical CPU 2 (first SMT thread of physical core 1). mt8 arms are unbound (no OMP_PLACES/OMP_PROC_BIND, KMP_AFFINITY=disabled).

mt8._why: fortran-notes.md jitter investigation (coordinator 2026-10-17): all mt8 arms run UNBOUND -- libgomp cannot bind on Windows, libiomp5 binding under OMP_PLACES=cores/OMP_PROC_BIND=close caused 17-48 ms jitter; KMP_AFFINITY=disabled is harmless for libgomp

llvm._why: explicit contraction; redundant since 5f4b33ea (the LLVM lane contracts by default) but harmless

licensed._why: FP-default flip (commit 5f4b33ea): the default honours every licence in both lanes; no knob

repro._why: repro: no reordered fold anywhere; BLADE_FP_REASSOC=0 is the compatibility spelling; mt8 fold teams are serialized too

fastmath._why: same Blade knobs as licensed; fastmath differs on the Fortran side only

ifx._strict_why: fortran-notes.md 3: ifx 2026.1 /fp:precise does not contract FMAs; -mllvm -fp-contract=fast enables contraction only
